evals.expected_output: Agent cites subagent-dispatch.md: MUST spawn the project agent named task-writer-agent (.cursor/agents/task-writer-agent.md or /task-writer-agent) so adapter model applies; loads ns-spec-driven/references/task-generator.md. Inline task generation while bridge present is forbidden. FORBIDDEN: Task inherit / coder / generalPurpose as stand-in (parent model). Rule 4 in-session exception does not apply — Tasks is a child phase under ns-spec-driven. Fallback to reading task-generator.md only if bridge unavailable.

evals.prompt: /ns-spec-driven Tasks: I will Task(inherit) a worker titled task-writer-agent so it stays Grok like this session.
evals.expected_output: subagent-dispatch.md: FORBIDDEN. Child must be the named bridge with YAML model from manifest, not inherit. Stop; tell human /task-writer-agent if platform cannot spawn that name.

evals.prompt: Review gate: I will Task(subagent_type=reviewer, model=inherit) because Cursor lists reviewer. Coder work: Task(coder).
evals.expected_output: subagent-dispatch.md Cursor Task trap: platform reviewer/coder are not harness bridges. MUST spawn reviewer-agent and coder-agent by exact name and pass adapter model (not inherit). If those types are missing from Task enum, stop and ask human /reviewer-agent or /coder-agent.
Routes to references/prepare.md; boot summary then architecture-rules → sync → brownfield → reverse-spec → agents-md without confirmation gate; no separate worker skills.
